$comment: Source of truth for which HostConfig settings a community lobby may change. Owner-maintained in DGHostBot; tools/lobby/gen.py publishes it (plus settings.md and lobby.schema.json) to the public pond-farmbot-lobbies repo. The host enforces the same list when it loads a lobby - it never trusts the repo.

forced.$comment: Applied to every community lobby, whatever the lobby file says.

RoundsToWin.about: Rounds a duck must win to take the match.

MatchStartSeconds.about: Lobby countdown once enough ducks are in.

MinimumPlayers.about: Ducks needed before a match starts.

MaximumPlayers.about: Lobby size cap. Over 8 needs base "24p".

WinByKills.about: Score by kills instead of rounds won.

SkipExcessRounds.about: End the match early once the result is decided.

MidGameJoining.about: Let ducks join during a match.

LobbyName.about: Name in the server browser. Duck Game colour tags like |DGGREEN| are allowed.

CustomMapsPercent.about: Share of rounds on custom maps (your lobby's maps folder). The four map percentages must add up to 100.

NormalMapsPercent.about: Share of rounds on the game's built-in maps.

RandomMapsPercent.about: Share of rounds on randomly generated maps.

InternetMapsPercent.about: Share of rounds on maps downloaded from the workshop.

MapScoresInRotation.about: Let skip votes and play counts push unpopular maps down the rotation.

EnableTerribleIdeas.about: Some rounds hand every duck the same cursed kit.

TerribleIdeaChance.about: Percent of rounds that are a Terrible Idea.

TerribleIdeaMinPlayers.about: Ducks needed for a Terrible Idea round.

EnableSuddenDeath.about: Long rounds turn into sudden death.

SuddenDeathSeconds.about: Seconds into a round before sudden death.

CarePackageMinSeconds.about: Earliest a care package can drop.

CarePackageMaxSeconds.about: Latest a care package can drop.

CarePackageMinAlive.about: Ducks alive needed for a drop.

SpawnKillPenaltyEnabled.about: RICOCHET: a kill right after GO kills the killer too.

SpawnKillGraceSeconds.about: How soon after GO a kill counts as a spawn-kill.

EnableAfkKick.about: Kick (never ban) ducks that stand still round after round.

AfkKickMinSeconds.about: And at least this long idle.

LagLimitMs.about: Ping where the lag monitor starts warning.

EnableTeamArmorBalance.about: Teams: armour for the short-handed side.

SkipVotePercent.about: Share of the room a skip/restart vote needs.

KickVotePercent.about: Share of the room a kick vote needs.

categories.name: Shop and loadouts
categories.$comment: Prices only take blues out of the economy, so they are safe to change. Floors stop a lobby from making power items nearly free.

EnableItemShop.about: @buy spawns an item next to you mid-round.

LoadoutPriceOverrides.about: Item name -> price inside a loadout.

LoadoutTapePremium.about: What taping two items together costs.

ExtraAmmoPercent.about: Extra-ammo upgrade, % of the item price.

InfiniteAmmoPercent.about: Infinite-ammo upgrade, % of the item price.

LoadoutDelaySeconds.about: Seconds after GO before loadouts can be bought.

EnableRoundBetting.about: Dead ducks bet on the final two.

EnableHouseBets.about: Farmbot offers priced bets of his own.

HouseBetWindowSeconds.about: How long a bet offer stays open.

ChatBudgetMatchPerMinute.about: Non-essential farmbot lines a minute during a round.

locked: Credentials and links: webhooks, YouTube keys, DevPassword, script paths.
What kind of server it is: Is1v1Server, stats reporting, Discord posting, streaming.
Anything that creates blues: challenge rewards, daily streaks, bounty payouts, tips, the guest tab, weekly payouts, give caps.
Ratings: community lobbies are always unrated.
Host plumbing: logging, keepalive, lobby watcher, restart rules, mode-switch rules.
